title: The Stirring of Jylkurfyk
summary: Chroniclers and northern delvers amid the petrified ice-timbers of the Frozen Forest race to renew the Dragon-Totem seals before a Barrow-King wakes in the Great Barrow of Jylkurfyk.

hook.rumour: Delvers returning to Kjolvik swear the petrified pines are ringing like iron bells as something hammers from inside the Great Barrow at Jylkurfyk.
hook.notice: KJOLVIK EXPEDITION CAMP: Delvers and rune-readers needed to restore the Dragon-Totem lintels between Kjolvik and Jylkurfyk.

npcs.name: Warden of Kjolvik
npcs.greet: Delvers returning to Kjolvik swear the petrified pines are ringing like iron bells as something hammers from inside the Great Barrow at Jylkurfyk.
talk: The trouble across the Atmoran Frozen Forest began when sealed dispatches started bypassing Kjolvik.
If you mean to help the Northern Chroniclers' Camp, start by checking the trail between Kjolvik and Atmoran Giants Cairn.

npcs.name: Chronicler of Kjolvik
npcs.greet: Keep your voice low—everyone at Atmoran Giants Cairn is watching who asks after the old seals.
talk: We traced the couriers from Atmoran Giants Cairn toward Skjaldborg before they vanished into the brush.
Bring any ciphered tallies back to Kjolvik so Chronicler-Captain Valdar can see the proof.

npcs.name: Outrider of Skjaldborg
npcs.greet: You made good time from Atmoran Giants Cairn. The saboteurs have fortified the approaches near Jylkurfyk.
talk: Their ringleader is holding the inner chamber at Jylkurfyk with a picked guard.
Once Jylkurfyk is cleared, return to Kjolvik to seal the regional compact.

npcs.name: Speaker of Kjolvik
npcs.greet: Chronicler-Captain Valdar awaits word on whether the crisis in the Atmoran Frozen Forest has been contained.
talk: The elders of Kjolvik have prepared the concord table for your return.
All of the Atmoran Frozen Forest owes you a debt for standing between Kjolvik and ruin.
